cover_letter_text:
Hi,

My name's Marc. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. You're looking for a junior or graduate project engineer in your civil construction team that works with local councils and tier one firms in South Australia, and I'd like to be considered.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on two building sites in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge and then as field engineer. I coordinated crews, did site inspections and quality checks, and kept progress and material records. In the diploma I designed roads, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start three weeks after an offer. I have a White Card, a full Victorian driver's licence, and full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
advert_text:
Remo Contractors Pty Ltd are offering an exciting full-time employment contract opportunity for a Junior/Graduate Civil Construction Project Engineer to join our family owned and operated business.
As our business opportunities expand, we are looking to add a highly motivated, results driven individual to our team.
Our Business
Remo Contractors Pty Ltd is a family owned business that provides civil construction, concrete and transport services to Local Government Councils, tier one firms and builders throughout South Australia. Our scope of works allows our employees to develop a broad range of skillsets whilst achieving job satisfaction in a rewarding work environment.
About the role
Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
- Define project objectives, scope, roles and responsibilities
- Work closely with the Senior Project Management Team
- Outline budgets based on requirements and tracking costs to deliver project on budget
- Ensure all work is completed in line with the company's quality management system
- Manage the relationship and communication with the client and all stakeholders, ensuring works are delivered to their satisfaction
- Management of sub-contractors, including performance monitoring and financial management
- Drafting and submitting progress claims and invoices
- Undertake frequent site inspections and audits to assess compliance to HSEQ policies and procedures
Skills & Experience
The successful candidate for this role must be able to demonstrate:
- Professional interpersonal and communications skills
- Good team player and effective leader who is able to motivate their project team
- Good time management skills and the ability to handle and prioritise multiple tasks at once
- Experienced in MS Office software
- A high level of verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills
- Highly developed time management, scheduling, planning and organizational skills with the ability to meet deadlines
- Must hold a current valid Australian Drivers Licence
- Must hold a Construction Industry White Card
The Successful Applicant
The successful applicant will be offered a full-time employment opportunity, with a generous remuneration package. Travelling to job sites in the metropolitan area will be required. A company vehicle will be provided when travel is required.
